studies.title: Harbour seals responded differently to pulses of out-migrating coho and Chinook smolts
studies.coast: Big Qualicum Estuary, Strait of Georgia, British Columbia, Canada
studies.field_vs_lab: field observational tide/diel effects around scheduled hatchery releases; tide/diel not randomized
studies.outcome: At least one accelerometer-derived prey encounter event (PEE) per hour while seal is within selected estuary hotspot
studies.model: Binomial logit mixed model, first component of hurdle model; fixed effects selected by AICc; separate zero-truncated negative-binomial count model must remain separate
studies.independent_unit: seal; 7 seals in Table2A/B; one estuary and study
studies.time_scope: May5–24,2015, comprising May5–14 post-coho and May15–24 post-Chinook
studies.tide_predictor: Hourly mean water height from Fisheries and Oceans Canada, Point Atkinson station; centered to mean0 and scaled to variance1 within time-of-day periods
studies.diel_definition: day/dusk/night/dawn using nautical twilight (sun 0–12 degrees below horizon for twilight)
studies.dependence: All coefficients are correlated outputs of one model. Individual seal and date/time rounded hourly are random effects. No coefficient covariance available. Do not treat 6 interactions or 2 release periods as independent studies.
studies.ci_label_warning: Original PDF caption visually reads CI: [25–95%]. Preserve numeric intervals as reported; do not silently label 95% CI. Use reported SE for numeric extraction, noting one-decimal rounding and z inconsistencies attributable potentially to rounding. Supplement TablesS3 and S7 also print [25%-95%]; supplement does not resolve the interval-level ambiguity.

raw_data_access.details: No linked machine-readable original dataset located in main PDF or targeted DOI searches. Original supplement acquired after following its published /articles/suppl/ URL; it contains methods, model selection, model tables and prediction figures, not raw observations.

classification_and_selection.PEE_definition: Two-cluster k-means classification of high vs low acceleration-variance sequences; high cluster sequences separated by less than1s count as PEE; wet/dry and haulout-adjacent10min exclusions
classification_and_selection.limitation: PEEs are proxy encounters, not validated successful captures in the wild. Hotspot boundary (top30% kernel density) and depth thresholds were selected using same PEE data. This is response-driven spatial selection, distinct from tide-defined behavioral labels.
classification_and_selection.exposure_limitation: Outside-hotspot times excluded; exact treatment of fractional time within hourly bins not verified from raw data.

studies.compatibility_note: Published Tide:Night compares slopes on tide normalized separately by diel period. It is a signed tide×diel interaction but is not a physical 1m slope difference or a low-v-high contrast. Need per-period tide scaling or original data before combining with spoonbill high/low logOR interaction.

supplement_validation.TableS4: Binomial presence model selects Tide×Time×Period, AICc1111.9; all pairwise interactions model1117.7, delta5.9
supplement_validation.TableS5: Positive-count model selects Tide+Time×Period, AICc1949.4; the absence of tide×diel in this selected model is not an estimated zero.
supplement_validation.FiguresS7_S9: Predicted probabilities with confidence bands for tide, diel and release interactions, not tabulated coefficient covariance.
supplement_validation.TableS7: Night-only tide×moon interaction0.7, SE0.2; lunar interaction is not a tide×solar/day-night interaction and is excluded from primary effects.

studies.title: Fine scale spatial variability in the influence of environmental cycles on the occurrence of dolphins at coastal sites
studies.body_vs_reference: Tide and diel both modeled in study body; all possible tensor interactions tested but only diel×season retained. Not a reference-only mention.
studies.outcome: Dolphin encounter presence/absence per recorded hour from passive acoustic CPOD; not counts of individual dolphins
studies.model: Site-specific binomial GAMMs with cyclic smooths; hour-lag presence or within-day AR1 to address serial correlation; year factor
studies.independent_unit: One population/coast, 3 sites; individuals unknown and may occur across sites. Hours and sites are dependent study samples, not independent studies.
studies.effect_decision: Do not encode discarded tide×diel terms as effect=0. Table3 omnibus smooth chi-square/AIC and Figure4 tidal curve95% bands do not provide a signed tide-by-day-night contrast with covariance.
studies.tide_source: Independent high/low times from UK Hydrographic Office reference ports within12km
studies.solar_phase: Sunset0/1, sunrise0.5; times between rescaled to seasonal day/night lengths
studies.tide_phase: High tide0/1, low tide0.5; cyclical phase, not height in metres

raw_data_access.file_status: Both public file clicks returnedHTTP403; no bypass/retry through alternate download path attempted

studies.detection_caution: Acoustic absence is not biological absence. Echolocation is behavioral; CPOD conservative sensitivity, and possible social/foraging changes affect detectability. States are not fitted using tide.
